player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitākaro {player_id} i Chopsticks. I runga i tou wā, whiri mai i tetahi o:
  + Whawhai:  '[attack M O]'  ka whai a, M= tou ringa (0 atau 1), O= ringa o te hoariri (0 atau 1).
    - Ka nui haere te ringa o te hoariri e tou ringa; ki te 5 ifua atu ranei, ka timata ki 0.
  + Wehe:   '[split L R]'  ki te whakawhiti koha i ou ngā ringa ki mua (L+R = ou katoa).
Whakautu ki tetahi o aua whakahau.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Kua mate kē te ringa o tō hoariri {opp_idx}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Me huri e Split te tohatoha o tō ringa.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Neke whakapae. Whakamahia “[attack M O]” atau “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: Ka whakaekea e P{player_id} te ringa o P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: ka haere mai i {opp_val} ki {new_val}.

outcome.win: Kua mate nga ringa e rua o te hoa whawhai.
